# How deep, and how soon, should you mark down what is left?

> Free clearance markdown planner for retailers and sellers. Enter the units you have left and the weeks you have; it estimates price elasticity from your own sales history and plans the week-by-week markdown that maximises expected revenue. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
